high_level_description: stc brand style, an ad composite showing a wifi router product beside a phone screen mockup of its setup app, over a purple background.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A solid deep purple background with a white horizontal accent stripe and a red color block.

elements.desc: A white cylindrical wifi router with visible ports, next to a hand pressing its power button.
A smartphone mockup displaying a purple setup screen with step instructions and a blue device icon.
White and red Arabic instructional text telling the user to press the power button for five seconds.
